text_block_list.text: One day, after training.

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
Ho-hoh, I see.
So this must be...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Ah, 'Parcae.'
Consider yourself lucky that I'm showing it to you.
Dr. Leitz and Air Shakur sat facing each other, discussing something while looking at the display.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I was just showing Dr. Wright
the code I put together.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"Seems like she understands a little bit of programming.
Though, how much she truly grasps is..."

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
――!!
Th-This is...

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
I see, if I apply this way of thinking—
Inspiration is surging through me!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Hm? Inspiration...?

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text: Excuse me for a moment!
Dr. Wright had already departed.
—A few days later.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Dr. Wright's taking his sweet time.
It's already training time.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: It seems they haven't shown up for the past few days, though.
choice_data_list: Shall we go take a look at the lab?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Tch... Can't be helped, jeez.

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, Air Shakur...
It's finally done... Take a look...

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text: It's all thanks to you showing me "Parcae." Once I integrate this program into the ST-2...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ââ!! This is...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: So you used "Parcae"'s computational simulator to predict the ground surface conditions. I see...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"To think it could be used like this...
Not bad, Professor. Not bad at all..."

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
No, the pleasure is mine, Air Shakur.
I never imagined I would meet a programmer of your caliber.

Hearts connected through code.
It was a communion in a language
only specialists could comprehend.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: "Still, with skills like that, they could've easily made a comfortable living as an engineer or something..."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Still, you... you were really fixated on ST-2, weren't ya?

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text: Ah, of course even I considered a different path at one point...

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
(After leaving Tracen Academy,
I chose robotics
as my second career.)

text_block_list.name: Fellow Researcher
text_block_list.text:
These are great blueprints! As expected of Sugar Lights.
Isn't this more of your true calling
than racing?

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text: You think so? Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text: (Her potential was unquestionable. But one day...)

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
"What nostalgic... footage...
This is from back when I was running in races..."

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
"I thought I'd forgotten...
Yet even now, this sensation flashes back..."

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Wait a second.
Transferring consciousness into a robot...
If that's possible...

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
"...There are many challenges to overcome.
But I will try once more. No matter what...!"

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
(Once I realized it,
I couldn't hold myself back anymore.)

text_block_list.name: Fellow Researcher
text_block_list.text:
Sugar Lights, don't overdo it.
That kind of research is reckless.

text_block_list.name: Fellow Researcher
text_block_list.text:
To synchronize one's consciousness with a robot,
and even make it run at the same speed as an Umamusume...

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
I know you might not understand.
Even so, no matter what, I...

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text: I want to accomplish this dream. I will definitely make it a reality.

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
"Though I once stepped away from running, even so...
I couldn't bring myself to completely abandon that little dream."

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
"Since I can't throw it away, I have no choice but to follow
the path I believe in. And prove it through my results."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I see...
You're one of those too, huh.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. People around us ain't gonna understand a thing
unless we shove the results in their faces. That's why...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(Even if I'm all alone, I just gotta keep believing.
In my own logic, and the future this research will bring.)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: (Parcae was created... for that very purpose.)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(The Nippon Derby, a race I could not win no matter how the dice fell.
To overturn that predicted future,
and overcome those insurmountable seven centimeters...)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Dr. Leitz, ST-2 and 'Parcae' are...
they're identical, through and through.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
In other words—the crystallization of conviction. There's something
I have to see through to the bitter end, too.

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
I see... You have a dream you cannot yield either...
That explains why this is so remarkably polished.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Ah...... By the way, Professor, I have a proposal.
—How about we sign an NDA?

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
"NDA?
A non-disclosure agreement, is it?"

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Don't tell anyone.
As long as you can agree to that...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"I'll teach you everything.
Every single skill and technique I possess."

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text: Air Shakur...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Use whatever you can however you like.
In return, let me use yours as I please.
And then, someday, without fail—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I will achieve it. The development of a robot
that can run at the same speed as an Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Sugar Lights
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it feels like I've gained the strength of a million allies.
I'm counting on you.

"Two souls betting their dreams on research.
Dr. Reits and Air Shakur found
common ground with one another."
